sentence: September's own cancer observance runs into an even stranger version of that same pattern: [this site's Prostate Cancer Awareness Month page](/prostate-cancer-awareness-month/) covers the one year, 2001, when the presidential proclamation named a different month entirely than the one Congress had asked for.
